question: Is the per-row member-optimality signal learnable by a strictly past-only gate, and does learning it convert into official Total?
method: Train a four-class gate on strictly earlier folds truncated so every training label was available before the target fold first basis time; apply hard pick, soft probability mixture and a 50/50 shrink toward the deployed blend.
chronology_contract: training rows require label_available <= first basis time of the target fold
